prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions remained overly optimistic overall, yet consistently underpredicted the magnitude of major winning tests.
New adoption flows (adoption, new_flow), home notifications (home, notification), sign-in reordering (sign_in, reorder), and choose path layouts (choose_path, layout) proved helpful, driving multiple winning tests.
New finish screens (finish, new_screen), finish redesigns (finish, redesign), and finish new flows (finish, new_flow) consistently generated negative metrics or guardrail rollbacks.
Finish hints (finish, hint), finish incentives (finish, incentive), home hints (home, hint), home new flows (home, new_flow), sign-in copy changes (sign_in, copy), and sign-in notifications (sign_in, notification) consistently resulted in no clear effect across multiple tests.
Evidence remains thin for change types tested only once (including adoption incentive, adoption wait_info, choose_path hint/incentive/new_flow/redesign, and sign_in layout/new_flow/redesign), requiring at least 2 agreeing tests to establish a pattern.

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_flow] Interactive Pet Adoption Customization Flow: Introduces an interactive customization flow on the pick friend screen allowing users to preview pet animations, custom colors, and sounds in real time. (why: New adoption flows drive consistent winning tests per lessons. Adoption step has 92.7% conversion but high median time (89s).)
1: [choose_path, layout] Choose Path Full Bleed Layout: Redesigns the choose path step into a full bleed visual layout emphasizing path choices with full-screen visuals. (why: Choose path layouts proved helpful in lessons. Choose path step has a high mean time of 514s indicating users need clear visual path distinction.)
2: [sign_in, reorder] Reorder Sign-In After Adoption Certificate Step: Moves sign-in immediately after the adoption certificate screen so users sign in only after completing pet adoption. (why: Sign-in reordering proved helpful in lessons. Support emails highlight 8 issues regarding pets missing after signing in.)
3: [home, notification] Waiting Screen Desktop Audio Launch Alert: Adds an audio launch alert badge and notification trigger on the waiting screen when background companion setup completes. (why: Home notifications proved helpful in lessons. The waiting/home transition has high median time (201s) and high drop-off.)
4: [adoption, new_flow] Adoption Certificate Interactive Celebration Flow: Adds an interactive celebration flow with animation and sound effects when confirming the adoption certificate. (why: New adoption flows drive high engagement according to lessons, strengthening completion intent before entering the waiting screen.)
5: [sign_in, redesign] Sign In Account Protection Redesign: Redesigns the sign-in screen using a spotlight layout with clear account pet-save assurances and cloud status indicators. (why: 8 support emails report pets missing or reset after signing in. Clarifying pet account protection on sign-in addresses top user complaints.)
6: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Habitat Generation Progress Details: Displays live stage generation updates and estimated time remaining during background asset creation on the waiting screen. (why: Home target step has median time 201s and mean 2336s. Detailed progress updates keep users informed while waiting.)
7: [sign_in, new_flow] Sign In Cloud Backup Verification Flow: Adds a cloud backup progress flow on the sign-in screen showing active profile sync status upon signing in. (why: Addresses 8 support tickets about missing pets after sign-in by visually verifying account sync during authentication.)
